Name: ofds_id
Title: Identifier
Description: A locally-unique identifier for this node.

Name: name
Title: Name
Description: A name for this node. The name should be unique amongst the nodes belonging to a network.

Name: phase
Title: Phase
Description: The phase to which this node belongs.

Name: status
Title: Status
Description: The status of this node, from the closed [nodeStatus codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodestatus).

Name: address__streetAddress
Title: Address Street address
Description: The physical address of this node. The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

Name: address__locality
Title: Address Locality
Description: The physical address of this node. The locality. For example, Mountain View.

Name: address__region
Title: Address Region
Description: The physical address of this node. The region. For example, CA.

Name: address__postalCode
Title: Address Postal code
Description: The physical address of this node. The postal code. For example, 94043.

Name: address__country
Title: Address Country
Description: The physical address of this node. The country in which the address is physically located, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

Name: supportingInfrastructure__type
Title: Supporting infrastructure Type
Description: The infrastructure that supports this node. The type of supporting infrastructure, from the open [nodeSupportingInfrastructure codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodesupportinginfrastructure).

Name: supportingInfrastructure__description
Title: Supporting infrastructure Description
Description: The infrastructure that supports this node. A description of the supporting infrastructure for this node.

Name: supportingInfrastructure__owner
Title: Supporting infrastructure Owner
Description: The infrastructure that supports this node. The organisation that owns the supporting infrastructure.

Name: supportingInfrastructure__spareCapacity
Title: Supporting infrastructure Spare capacity
Description: The infrastructure that supports this node. Whether the supporting infrastructure has spare capacity for the installation of additional network equipment.

Name: accessPoint
Title: Access point
Description: Whether active or passive transmission equipment is installed at this node which is capable of providing access to the network.

Name: power
Title: Power availability
Description: Whether power for active network equipment is available at this node.

Name: transmissionMediumOwner
Title: Transmission medium owner
Description: The organisation that owns the transmission media for this node, i.e. the passive network equipment such as splitters, combiners and fibre distribution panels.
